HasAdvancementDef.description: The player has earned an advancement: a realm's unlock, ``realmforge:realm/<realm>``, for example.
HasAdvancementDef.title: HasAdvancementDef

LevelAtLeastDef.description: The player's character level is at least ``level``.

level.description: The lowest character level that passes.
level.title: Level

LevelAtLeastDef.title: LevelAtLeastDef

MobLevelRuleDef.description:
How the level of a mob spawning in the dimension follows the nearest player (RLM-240, architecture 14.1):
near the player's level, by ``weights`` for the offsets around it, never below its floor nor above
``max_level``. The floor is ``entry_level`` (the realm's), or the highest of ``structure_floors`` whose structure
holds the spot (RLM-342).

entry_level.description: The realm's floor: the level needed to enter it. No mob that spawns there is lower, and a player below it meets every mob at it. A mob that comes through a realm portal keeps the level it has.
entry_level.title: Entry Level

max_level.description: The highest level a mob there gets.
max_level.title: Max Level

structure_floors.description: Optional: structures that raise the floor of the mobs they hold, each above entry_level, one entry per structure or tag. A mob that gets its level inside a piece of one of them is never below its level, and inside several, never below the highest.
structure_floors.title: Structure Floors

weights.description: The weight of each offset from the nearest player's level, lowest first, the middle one for the player's own level: [5, 10, 20, 30, 20, 10, 5] is -3 to +3. An odd number of weights, each 1 to 1000; the floor and the cap drop offsets, and the rest share the chance by their weights.
weights.title: Weights

MobLevelRuleDef.title: MobLevelRuleDef

StructureFloorDef.description:
A structure's floor (RLM-342): a mob that gets its level inside one of the structure's pieces is never below
``level``.

level.description: The lowest level of a mob that gets its level inside one of the structure's pieces: above the rule's entry_level, at most its max_level. A player below it meets every such mob at it.
level.title: Level

structure.description: A structure, e.g. minecraft:ancient_city, or a structure tag after #, e.g. #minecraft:village. Validated against the ID universe.
structure.title: Structure

StructureFloorDef.title: StructureFloorDef

description:
The gameplay rules of one dimension, which the ``dimension`` field names: the rule for mob levels and what a
player needs to enter it. At most one entry per dimension.

access.description: Optional: what a player needs to enter the dimension, every requirement at once; refused on every way in (a portal, a command, a warp). A realm's rules name its unlock advancement (realm portal spec).
access.title: Access

dimension.description: The dimension these rules are for, e.g. minecraft:overworld.
dimension.title: Dimension

id.description: Lowercase snake_case id; becomes realmforge:<id>. Must equal the file name.
id.title: Id

mob_levels.description: Optional: the level of mobs spawning there. Without it, mobs have no level.

title: DimensionRulesDef
